Axiom:
When an audit round triggers a ticket reopen, the read-only audit worker returns the proposed round summary; after acceptance, the execute orchestrator's bounded administrative ticket channel appends it under a new `## Audit Rounds` section so the reopen history lives next to the Execution Log rounds it caused. Format per `TICKET_AUDIT_ROUND_FORMAT`. Append-only: prior audit rounds in the ticket are immutable.
Rationale: full ephemeral output loses reopen-causation between rounds; `audits/.audit.md` separate-tree was overkill. Co-locating the audit round with the Execution Log it caused keeps history reviewable in one file.
Per-task audits that PASS without triggering a reopen produce no ticket write — they remain ephemeral.
Epic-level audits never touch ticket files; their consolidated output is ephemeral OR routed to a scope-spec Decision Log entry.
